definitions.branch_target_shape: empty | hex (0x...) | dec (digits) | register (an ARM64 register name) | other, applied to the instruction target field
definitions.differing_field_paths: number of ir documents whose difference set includes the field path, after removing the two added top-level objects; '.[] (length)' means the two lists had different lengths
definitions.exclusive_instruction_reason: for an address present on only one side, the nearest earlier instruction in address order that is not itself exclusive to that side; 'after_trap:<mnemonic>' when that instruction is brk/hlt/udf, otherwise 'after_<op>'
definitions.instruction_alignment: instructions are matched between the two sides by virtual address within the same function
definitions.op_transitions: for an address present on both sides, '<reference op>-><candidate op>' when the op differs
definitions.operand_naming_direction: unified diff with zero context; hunks that replace exactly one line with exactly one line, compared by the number of regN tokens on each side
definitions.operand_naming_fewer_register_classes: the fewer_registers pairs, enumerated in operand-direction-losses.tsv
definitions.pseudocode_line_tags: regex tags per added or removed line of a zero-context unified diff; a line can carry several tags
